hftest — A Hartree-Fock Program in C++23

hftest is a self-contained Restricted and Unrestricted Hartree-Fock (RHF/UHF) program written in modern C++23. It uses LibTorch for all linear algebra, reads molecular geometry and settings from a TOML input file, and loads basis sets from Basis Set Exchange (BSE) Gaussian-format files.
